conclusion.classification: reproducible transient stale-Service client-failure pattern and repeatable observed outage extension; availability-regression candidate
limits: Only two full-churn trials with client probes and their matched controls.
The fault delays correct Deployment/Service creation by about 1.1–1.3 seconds in both full-churn pairs; the full 2.6–4.9-second outage difference also includes variable Pod readiness and DNS timing.
Both control and fault Deployments use a 10-second TCP readiness probe; this experiment did not isolate probe timing from the churn intervention.
Fresh connections and read-only aggregate queries only; no persistent-session/write/transaction guarantee tested.
No persistent outage, bad successful query result, direct-database failure, or post-convergence query failure observed.
